assumptions.data: SPY close from Yahoo Finance auto_adjust=True; CBOE VIX close
assumptions.iv_source: CBOE VIX used as implied volatility
assumptions.option_bid_ask_haircut: 5% applied to option theoretical value on entry and exit
assumptions.option_commission: $0.65 per option leg/contract; entry and close applied
assumptions.hedge_slippage: 5 bps of SPY notional on hedge trades
assumptions.gamma_cost_model: gamma_cost_mult=0.7 configured; cumulative_gamma_cost remains 0.0 in current strategy accounting because daily gamma scalping is captured in BSM MTM and only hedge execution costs are deducted
assumptions.fill_assumption: daily close mark-to-market; no explicit next-open fill model
